subject: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@cloudlinesys.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation

Hi Rajiv,

Quick note following our call this morning — congrats again on getting buy-in from the platform team. I understand procurement has the PO queued but there may be a multi-week review. To avoid blocking your engineers from completing the dedicated-load tests, would a short burst of credits (sandbox access) help you continue validation while the PO clears?

Proposed parameters: up to 500k tokens of sandbox credits, valid for 14 days, non-recurring. If that works I can route an approval through sales ops and finance for a constrained promo allocation.

Attaching the evaluation plan you shared so our ops team can match the usage profile.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Cloudline-eval-plan.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@cloudlinesys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: cloudline-sales@cloudlinesys.com
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation

Jordan — thanks, that would be very helpful. Procurement confirmed the PO was submitted yesterday but they estimated 10–18 business days to complete an external vendor review and negotiate T&C.

If you can provide a 14-day window and ~450k tokens, that should cover our scale tests and a final security touchpoint. We only need API access (no E2E prod traffic) and a way to throttle if we accidentally spike.

I can confirm the PO number once procurement emails it through — ETA next Friday.

Best,
Rajiv
Head of Platform, Cloudline Systems

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation

Jordan / Stephanie — I reviewed this with Sales Ops and Finance. We can approve a one-time sandbox allocation under the following constraints:

- Allocation: 500,000 token-equivalent credits, expiring 14 days after activation.
- Scope: API-only, non-production tenant, throttling cap at 1200 tokens/sec.
- No auto-renew; any extension requires PO + formal request.
- Promo ID: PROMO-CL-14D-500K (one-time use tied to deal CL-2026-0927).

Jordan, please confirm with Rajiv that the scope/limits are acceptable. Stephanie, I left the promo code in the internal console; once Jordan confirms I will push it to the Cloudline tenant (sandbox) and drop the confirmation text file in the thread.

Olga
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@cloudlinesys.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation

Rajiv — thanks, that sounds perfect. We will provision: 500,000 token credits, 14-day window, API-only sandbox, throttling at 1200 tokens/sec. Promo ID PROMO-CL-14D-500K.

I attached a short confirmation text you can forward internally if procurement wants written proof the sandbox access is time limited. Activation will happen after I confirm your preferred start time (can begin today or on Monday).

If procurement sends the PO earlier, we will reconcile usage against the PO and either absorb the promo usage or convert it into billable usage per contract.

Thanks — let me know when you want us to flip the switch.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: temporary-credits-confirmation.txt (text/plain)
From: Rajiv Mehta <rajiv.mehta@cloudlinesys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: cloudline-sales@cloudlinesys.com
Date: 2026-11-06T15:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short burst credits while PO pending - Cloudline evaluation

Jordan / Olga — confirmed, please start the allocation today. Procurement expects to send the official PO by 2026-11-13 but our engineers can begin tests immediately. I will forward the PO number once it arrives.

Appreciate the quick turn here — this removes a blocker for our performance gating.

Rajiv
Head of Platform, Cloudline Systems
